typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Summary, Description = CONVERT(varchar(max),Description), IssueType, [Fix Version], [Labels], [WorkID], SystemList, [Issue Priority], [IT Team], Component, DueDate FROM (  SELECT DISTINCT   			Summary = \'Table Out Of Sync Impacting - \'+[OutOfSyncTableName]+\'\' 		  		   ,Description =  isnull(\'Table impacted \'+[OutOfSyncTableName]+\' \'+ CHAR(13)+CHAR(10)  		                   ,\'\') 		                 + isnull(\'Processes Impacted in DX: \'+[ImpactedProcesses]+\' \' + CHAR(13)+CHAR(10),\'\') 						 + isnull(\'Date Of Issue: \'+convert(varchar(10), [DateOfIssue], 120)+\' \' + CHAR(13)+CHAR(10),\'\')					 						 +isnull(\'Resolution Date: \'+convert(varchar(10), [ResolutionDate], 120)	 						 ,\'\') 		   ,IssueType = \'Task\' 		    ,[Fix Version] = convert(varchar, DATEADD(d, -1, DATEADD(m, DATEDIFF(m, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0)), 23)+\',DX_OOS\'  		   ,Labels =		\'GBD_DataExchange_InProgress\' 		   ,WorkID =		\'PRJ0018738\' 						 		   ,SystemList =	\'041800001FH4\'            ,Status =		\'ready\' 		   ,[Issue Priority] = \'Critical\' 		   ,[IT Team] = 			 \'Data Exchange\' 		   ,Component = 		 \'DX-VendorExchanges\' 		   ,DueDate = CONVERT(varchar, GETDATE() + 1, 101) FROM        DATA_EXCHANGE.dbo.[JIRA_OOS_DX_Impacts]                                        WHERE  convert(varchar,DateInserted, 101) = convert(varchar, getdate(), 101) ) JA',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		IT_Team as string,
		SystemList as string,
		Description as string,
		Issue_Priority as string,
		IssueType as string,
		Fix_Version as string,
		Summary as string,
		Labels as string,
		WorkID as string,
		Component as string,
		DueDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		IT_Team = {IT Team},
		SystemList,
		Description,
		Issue_Priority = {Issue Priority},
		IssueType,
		Fix_Version = {Fix Version},
		Summary,
		Labels,
		WorkID,
		Component,
		DueDate)) ~> FlatFileDestination
